items.summary: A California father is pursuing a legal battle alleging discriminatory treatment of Asian-American students in college admissions. A federal judge partially granted a motion to dismiss claims against the University of Washington, allowing the case to proceed to discovery. The family argues their son, Stanley Zhong, was unfairly rejected by 16 of 18 colleges despite a 1590 SAT score and strong credentials. The University of Washington stated it was pleased many claims were dismissed and emphasized the competitiveness of its admissions process. The family hopes accessing internal records will reveal if Asian-American applicants faced different treatment.
items.title: Father seeks court approval for bias claims after son rejected by 16 colleges

key_points: The Hyderabad Cricket Association is conducting open selection trials for women in different categories at the Rajiv Gandhi International Cricket Stadium.
Trials are scheduled for September 1, 2, and 3 for Girls Under-15, Girls Under-19, and Senior Women and Under-23 categories.
The HCA said spot registrations are allowed and players must wear colored cricket dress while carrying birth certificates and Aadhaar cards.
Eligibility dates range from 2011 for Under-15 players to 2003 for Senior Women and Under-23 players.
items.summary: The Hyderabad Cricket Association announced open selection trials for women cricketers at the Rajiv Gandhi International Cricket Stadium in Uppal. Trials will occur on September 1, 2, and 3 for various age categories. The HCA stated that spot registrations are permitted and specified dress code requirements. Participants must carry birth certificates and Aadhaar cards.
items.title: Hyderabad Cricket Association Announces Open Selection Trials for Women Cricketers

key_points: Residents of Katara Hills in Bhopal burned an effigy of the Bhopal Municipal Corporation to protest poor civic amenities.
Mahendra Nareda stated that Ward 85 faces severe infrastructure issues including potholes and non-functional streetlights.
Resident Mahesh Vashishtha alleged that rain has caused waterlogging and garbage accumulation despite repeated complaints to officials.
The Congress party warned it would blockade the BMC headquarters if problems are not resolved within 15 days.
items.summary: Residents of Katara Hills in Bhopal burned an effigy of the Bhopal Municipal Corporation to protest poor civic amenities. Mahendra Nareda stated that Ward 85 faces severe infrastructure issues including potholes and non-functional streetlights. Resident Mahesh Vashishtha alleged that rain has caused waterlogging and garbage accumulation despite repeated complaints to officials. The Congress party warned it would blockade the BMC headquarters if problems are not resolved within 15 days.
items.title: Katara Hills Residents Burn BMC Effigy Over Potholes, Garbage And Waterlogging

key_points: Ethiopians Emane Seifu and Seboka Negusse claimed first place in the women's and men's elite categories.
Gopi Thonakal finished fourth in the men's race with a time of 2:21:46.
Nirmaben Thakor was the best Indian finisher in the women's category, placing sixth.
Kenyan athletes Felix Kimutai and Francis Cheruiyot secured second and third places in the men's elite.
items.summary: Ethiopians Emane Seifu and Seboka Negusse won the women's and men's categories at the 15th Hyderabad Marathon. Gopi Thonakal finished fourth in the men's elite race, while Nirmaben Thakor placed sixth in the women's elite. The event saw strong performances from Kenyan athletes in the top three positions for both categories. Indian runners Gopi Thonakal and Nirmaben Thakor were the top finishers representing India in their respective divisions.
items.title: Ethiopians Win Hyderabad Marathon; Gopi and Nirmaben Lead Indian Finishers

key_points: Iranian state media reported explosions near Larak island following US attacks on Revolutionary Guard rocket launchers.
An anonymous Iranian official stated forces were preparing to launch rockets and sea mines into the strait.
The US military recently completed clearing sea mines from the Hormuz Strait's international shipping routes.
The Revolutionary Guard reported injuries to fighters and promised punishment for the aggressor.
items.summary: Iranian state media reported explosions near Larak island after US forces attacked Revolutionary Guard Corps rocket launchers. An anonymous official stated IRGC units were preparing to fire rockets and sea mines into the strait. The US military recently cleared sea mines from international shipping routes in the area. The Revolutionary Guard announced the martyrdom and injury of several fighters and vowed punishment for the aggressor.
items.title: US strikes Iranian rocket launchers in Hormuz Strait

key_points: A U.S. official stated that U.S. forces struck Iranian rocket launchers on the Strait of Hormuz.
Semiofficial Iranian news outlets reported explosions near Larak island following the strike.
Iran's Revolutionary Guards vowed to respond to the attack after claiming several casualties.
The U.S. military had recently completed clearing sea mines from the strait's shipping routes.
items.summary: U.S. forces struck Iranian rocket launchers on the Strait of Hormuz in the first military action in weeks, a U.S. official said Sunday. Semiofficial Iranian outlets reported explosions near Larak island, while a U.S. official noted Revolutionary Guard forces were preparing to launch rockets with sea mines. The U.S. military recently cleared sea mines from the strait's international shipping routes. Iran's Revolutionary Guards vowed to respond to the attack, which they claimed killed and wounded fighters and civilians, though they did not provide a precise casualty toll.
items.title: U.S. forces strike Iranian rocket launchers on the Strait of Hormuz

key_points: Delhi police arrested a day care employee two days after a father filed a complaint alleging physical assault and sexual harassment of his three-year-old son.

A case was registered against the staff member, school director, principal, and teacher under Sections 115(2), 126(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.
CCTV footage obtained by the father purportedly showed the child being tied to a chair, slapped, and having his ears pulled while other children played.
The father stated the school director demanded ₹1,500 to access the footage and claimed children were beaten daily, while a medico-legal report recorded physical assault and swelling.
Police are attempting to arrest the other three accused and will take legal action after reviewing all evidence.
items.summary: Delhi police arrested a staff member at a private day care in Jaffrabad following a father's complaint of physical and sexual abuse against his three-year-old son. Authorities registered a case against the employee, director, principal, and teacher under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and POCSO. CCTV footage allegedly showed the child being tied to a chair and assaulted while other children played nearby. The father stated the school demanded payment to access the video and that the director claimed such abuse was common. Medical reports confirmed physical injuries including swelling and abrasions on the child.
items.title: Delhi police arrest day care employee after father alleges child assault

key_points: Air India confirmed the delivery of its fourth custom Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner at Delhi.
The new aircraft is intended for medium and long-haul passenger routes.
The carrier is retrofitting 26 legacy Boeing 787-8 Dreamliners with refreshed interiors.
Air India aims to have 60% of its widebody fleet feature modern cabins by 2026.
items.summary: Air India announced the arrival of its fourth custom-made Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner at Delhi airport. The airline stated the fresh aircraft will operate on medium and long-haul routes as part of its ongoing transformation programme. Additionally, the carrier is retrofitting 26 legacy Boeing 787-8 Dreamliners with upgraded cabins. Air India expects nearly 60% of its widebody fleet to feature modern interiors by the end of 2026.
items.title: Air India receives fourth custom Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner at Delhi

key_points: The Madhya Pradesh School Education Department began allotting schools for nearly 7,000 Class-3 teachers on Monday.
The Directorate of Public Instruction delayed the process after teachers objected to their proposed posting locations.
Approximately 400 teachers utilized a new mutual transfer facility to exchange their allotted locations.
Selected teachers will be given one week to join their respective schools following the allotment.
The second phase of waiting counselling for Class-2 teachers also starts on Monday.
items.summary: The Madhya Pradesh School Education Department has started the school allotment process for nearly 7,000 selected Class-3 teachers. The Directorate of Public Instruction initially delayed postings due to teacher objections regarding locations. To resolve this, the department offered mutual transfers to around 400 teachers, which were completed before the process began. Selected teachers will have one week to join their assigned schools after allotment. Additionally, waiting counselling for Class-2 teachers will commence on Monday.
items.title: MP Education Department Begins Allotment for 7,000 Class-3 Teachers

key_points: Swiss police are conducting a nationwide search for suspects after a shooting at an Aarau rave killed a 22-year-old woman and injured five others.
Investigators are considering terrorism, a mass shooting, or another criminal motive as potential reasons for the attack.
Police have deployed armed officers and armoured vehicles while cordoning off large areas of the town.
Authorities are appealing to the public for any photographs or videos that could help identify those responsible.
items.summary: Swiss police have launched a nationwide manhunt following a shooting at a rave in Aarau that killed one woman and injured five others. Authorities are treating terrorism, a mass shooting, and other criminal motives as equally likely possibilities. Police have cordoned off large parts of the town and are appealing for public assistance in identifying suspects. The incident occurred at a techno event where approximately 3,500 people were expected to attend.
items.title: Swiss police launch nationwide manhunt after rave shooting in Aarau

key_points: Investors Business Daily states that S&P 500 investors will watch Treasury yields, Fed rate hike odds, and the August jobs report next week.
The Russell 2000 dropped 1.5% for the week, falling below its 50-day moving average for the first time in about a month.
Federal Reserve rate hike odds jumped to around 58% from about 35% after Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech.
Investors Business Daily advises investors to stay selective and focus on companies showing strong price action and good earnings.
items.summary: Investors Business Daily reports that Wall Street enters a key week where S&P 500 investors will monitor Treasury yields, Federal Reserve rate hike probabilities, and the upcoming August jobs report. Major indexes ended the previous week higher, though Investors Business Daily notes underlying weakness in sectors like small caps and energy. Software stocks remain a focal point as the sector shows strong momentum, while the Federal Reserve's rate hike odds have jumped to around 58% following comments by Kevin Warsh. The publication advises investors to stay selective ahead of earnings from companies like Dell and Snowflake, and to watch whether market strength broadens beyond megacaps. Caution remains important as Friday's selling demonstrated that stocks can turn lower quickly.
items.title: Investors watch S&P 500, Fed rate odds, and jobs report next week

key_points: Ravi Kishan told a gathering in Gorakhpur that the city feels like Spain because of its growth.
Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath laughed at the actor-politician's comparison during the speech.
The Congress Party posted a video mocking the claim by showing waterlogged areas in Gorakhpur.
Social media users joked that Gorakhpur feels like Spain without the letter 'S' or compared it to Venice.
Ravi Kishan has not retracted his remarks following the political and online backlash.
items.summary: Ravi Kishan stated at a Gorakhpur event that the city feels like Spain due to its development. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath laughed at the comparison, which quickly spread on social media. The Congress Party criticized the remark by posting a video contrasting local waterlogging with Spanish infrastructure. Internet users also mocked the comparison, suggesting Gorakhpur resembles Venice instead. Kishan has not withdrawn his comments despite the criticism.
items.title: Ravi Kishan compares Gorakhpur to Spain, prompting laughter and political backlash

key_points: A landslide near Bridge No. 57 on the Shimla-Kalka UNESCO World Heritage railway disrupted services after heavy rain washed away soil beneath the track.
Northern Railway cancelled operations until September 1 and short-terminated four trains to ensure safety.
Officials evacuated over 400 passengers and staff by road using seven vehicles.
No complaints or refund requests were registered at Kalka station following the incident.
items.summary: A landslide near Bridge No. 57 on the Shimla-Kalka UNESCO World Heritage railway disrupted services after heavy rain washed away soil beneath the track. Northern Railway cancelled operations until September 1 and short-terminated four trains to ensure safety. Officials evacuated over 400 passengers and staff by road using seven vehicles. No complaints or refund requests were registered at Kalka station following the incident.
items.title: Landslide damages Shimla-Kalka heritage railway, cancelling four trains until September 1

key_points: Dipika Kakar and Shoaib Ibrahim shared vlogs celebrating Eid and Raksha Bandhan with their families.
Dipika documented her liver cancer infusion treatment while her son Ruhaan assisted with prayer preparations.
Shoaib prepared kheer, accompanied his wife to the hospital, and celebrated Rakhi with his sister and niece.
Shoaib revealed plans to open a limited-menu restaurant but stated financial constraints currently delay the project.
items.summary: Television couple Dipika Kakar and Shoaib Ibrahim shared festival vlogs celebrating Eid and Raksha Bandhan with family. Dipika documented her liver cancer infusion treatment while her son assisted with prayers. Shoaib prepared kheer, accompanied his wife to the hospital, and celebrated Rakhi with his sister and niece. He revealed plans to open a limited-menu restaurant but noted financial constraints currently delay the project.
items.title: Dipika Kakar and Shoaib Ibrahim share Eid and Rakhi vlogs and restaurant plans

key_points: SpaceX stock recovered to approximately $140 after a sharp decline from a peak near $225.
The company reported a 92% revenue increase to $7.8 billion while spending $18.4 billion on capital investments.
AI infrastructure spending reached $15.8 billion as AI-related revenue grew 247% to $2.6 billion.
Starship development aims to increase annual launch capacity to over 1 million tons, though the rocket remains under development.
items.summary: SpaceX stock has recovered to around $140 after falling from a peak near $225, according to Yahoo Finance analysis. The article explains that recent volatility stems from high investor expectations, massive capital spending, and the long-term potential of the Starship rocket. SpaceX reported a 92% year-over-year revenue increase to approximately $7.8 billion, yet its capital investments reached $18.4 billion in the second quarter, with $15.8 billion allocated to AI infrastructure. Meanwhile, AI-related revenue jumped 247% to $2.6 billion. The analysis highlights that while Starship aims to increase launch capacity to millions of tons annually, the company remains valued at roughly $1.9 trillion. Investors now focus on whether SpaceX can generate returns from its heavy spending and deliver on Starship's technical goals.
items.title: SpaceX stock rises as investors weigh AI spending and Starship plans

visual.alt: Bar chart. Debut $135 $; Peak $225 $; Low $105 $; Recovery $140 $; Valuation $3 $; Revenue $7.8 $; Spending $18.4 $.

key_points: SBI and SBI Capital Markets plan to dilute a combined stake of up to 1% in NSE via an IPO.
SBI Chairman C S Setty confirmed the divestment of 0.65% by the bank and 0.35% by the subsidiary.
The bank noted that the final dilution amount could be lower if other shareholders join the offering.
Setty stated the mortgage portfolio is set to cross 10 lakh crore in the current quarter.
items.summary: SBI Chairman C S Setty stated the bank and its subsidiary plan to dilute up to 1% of their NSE stake through a proposed IPO. SBI currently holds 3.23% while SBI Capital Markets owns 4.33% of the exchange. The bank clarified there are no immediate monetization plans for other subsidiaries. Additionally, Setty highlighted that the mortgage portfolio is expected to cross the 10 lakh crore milestone this quarter.
items.title: SBI plans to dilute up to 1% NSE stake via IPO

key_points: Four armed men were killed in a shootout with a joint Meghalaya Police and ATS team in East Garo Hills.
The encounter happened around 4 am when the team set up a checkpoint following intelligence inputs.
Police-ATS personnel signaled a vehicle to stop, but occupants allegedly opened fire first.
The four men sustained serious injuries and were declared dead at a hospital.
Authorities are verifying the men's identities and investigating possible links to a recent kidnapping and killing in Damra.
items.summary: Four armed men died after an exchange of fire with a joint Meghalaya Police and ATS team in East Garo Hills. The encounter occurred early Sunday morning at a checkpoint near Songsak and Kagal. Police-ATS personnel signaled a vehicle to stop, but occupants allegedly opened fire first. The four men sustained serious injuries and were declared dead at a hospital. Authorities are verifying their identities and investigating possible links to a recent kidnapping and killing in Damra.
items.title: Four armed men killed in shootout with Meghalaya Police-ATS in East Garo Hills

key_points: Former SEBI chairman UK Sinha stated the regulator could have improved preparation for the closing auction session.
He noted concerns regarding liquidity and price volatility but expressed confidence in eventual stabilization.
The mechanism, launched on August 3, replaced continuous trading with an auction process for F&O stocks.
Market participants have raised issues about liquidity, while SEBI recently penalized entities for alleged manipulation.
items.summary: Former SEBI chairman UK Sinha stated the regulator could have improved preparation for the closing auction session. He noted concerns regarding liquidity and price volatility but expressed confidence in eventual stabilization. The mechanism, launched on August 3, replaced continuous trading with an auction process for F&O stocks. Market participants have raised issues about liquidity, while SEBI recently penalized entities for alleged manipulation. Sinha emphasized that the auction makes manipulation easier to detect and suggested investor suitability checks to mitigate risks.
items.title: Former SEBI Chairman UK Sinha Says Regulator Could Have Better Prepared Closing Auction

key_points: Subhash Chandra stated that HDFC Group claims of ₹775 crore are made without a valid personal guarantee.
Chandra's office reported that total outstanding dues to lenders amount to ₹4,262 crore after excluding certain accounts.
The NCLT approved a repayment plan allowing Chandra to repay ₹6.5 crore against admitted claims of over ₹22,000 crore.
Chandra hopes lenders will reconcile outstanding accounts and recover their dues through engagement with borrowers.
items.summary: Zee Group Founder Subhash Chandra questioned HDFC Group claims regarding a ₹775 crore outstanding balance, stating they lack a valid personal guarantee. His office clarified that total lender dues amount to ₹4,262 crore, differing from earlier figures due to excluded accounts. Chandra's statement outlined a repayment plan allowing him to pay ₹6.5 crore against admitted claims exceeding ₹22,000 crore. He expressed hope that lenders will reconcile accounts and recover dues while engaging with borrowers.
items.title: Subhash Chandra questions HDFC claims and seeks reconciliation of ₹4,262 crore dues

key_points: Abhijeet Dipke told the BJP to listen to RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat.
Dipke asserted that the BJP is in power because of the RSS.
He criticized PM Narendra Modi for not following Bhagwat's guidance on terminology.
Dipke addressed Sonam Wangchuk's remarks about CJP leaders having political ambition.
items.summary: Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke stated that the BJP should listen to RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat. Dipke claimed the ruling party believes it has grown larger than its mentor organization. He criticized Prime Minister Narendra Modi for using the term 'Dimagi Naxal' instead of following Bhagwat's advice. Additionally, Dipke responded to Sonam Wangchuk's comments regarding CJP leaders' political ambitions.
items.title: CJP leader Dipke urges BJP to heed RSS chief Bhagwat

key_points: Senior journalist Vivek Deshpande stated that RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat's Madison Square Garden address represented an attempt to rebuild the organization's image.
Deshpande argued there is a contradiction between Bhagwat's message of unity and the RSS's conduct in India.
Political commentator Pushparaj Deshpande suggested the group is positioning itself within the global conservative landscape while maintaining a conciliatory image abroad.
Professor Ajay Gudavarthy questioned whether the concept of oneness is compatible with genuine pluralism and the idea of a Hindu Rashtra.
Professor Tanvir Aeijaz emphasized the need to revisit secularism as a core constitutional principle rather than relying solely on interfaith dialogue.
items.summary: Senior journalist Vivek Deshpande stated that RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat's Madison Square Garden address represented an attempt to rebuild the organization's image. Deshpande argued there is a contradiction between Bhagwat's message of unity and the RSS's conduct in India. Political commentator Pushparaj Deshpande suggested the group is positioning itself within the global conservative landscape while maintaining a conciliatory image abroad. Professor Ajay Gudavarthy questioned whether the concept of oneness is compatible with genuine pluralism and the idea of a Hindu Rashtra. Professor Tanvir Aeijaz emphasized the need to revisit secularism as a core constitutional principle rather than relying solely on interfaith dialogue. The panel debated whether the speech marked a genuine recalibration or a strategic international outreach effort.
items.title: RSS Chief Bhagwat's New York Speech Sparks Debate on Image and Ideology

key_points: Prime Minister Narendra Modi urged citizens to unite against drug abuse during his 'Mann Ki Baat' address.
He highlighted that the PM SVANidhi Yojana has helped approximately 35 lakh women expand their businesses.
The 'Mission ShaktiSAT' initiative provides satellite technology training to 12,000 girl students from 108 countries.
Modi noted the global journey of the Indian tricolour and the rising demand for avocados benefiting farmers.
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi appealed to citizens during his monthly 'Mann Ki Baat' address to unite against drug abuse and support the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan. He stated that addiction impacts not just individuals but entire families and society. The Prime Minister highlighted the PM SVANidhi Yojana, noting that approximately 35 lakh women are expanding their businesses through the scheme. He also discussed the 'Mission ShaktiSAT' initiative, which offers satellite technology training to 12,000 girl students from 108 countries. Additionally, Modi mentioned the global journey of the Indian tricolour and the rising demand for avocados benefiting farmers. The broadcast concluded with stories of individuals contributing to society through various initiatives.
items.title: Modi urges citizens to unite against drug abuse in Mann Ki Baat

key_points: Dunham's memoir details how fame exacerbated her chronic autoimmune and inflammatory conditions.
The book explores her dysfunctional friendship with producer Jenni Konner and her relationship with her parents.
Dunham describes suffering from multiple illnesses including OCD, colitis, and endometriosis while maintaining a public career.
The author argues that the corporate-medicine nexus does not want women to heal from gynaecological illnesses.
items.summary: Lena Dunham's new memoir, 'Famesick', details her struggles with chronic illness and the intense scrutiny of fame. The authors report that Dunham describes how stress worsened her autoimmune conditions while she worked on the hit show 'Girls'. She explains that her fame transformed into a sickness, forcing her to endure public interest in her body despite severe health issues. Dunham also discusses her complex relationships with her parents and her best friend, producer Jenni Konner. The book reveals her diagnosis with multiple conditions including OCD, colitis, and endometriosis, which she says the medical system failed to address rigorously. Dunham frames her story as a writer would a novel, focusing on the eternal struggle to inhabit one's body.
items.title: Lena Dunham explores fame, chronic illness and Hollywood in new memoir

key_points: The Bombay High Court criticized the Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration for mechanically refusing to revoke suspended licences of five Mumbai eateries.
The bench expressed displeasure that an official failed to apply his mind to a previous court direction.
Acting Chief Justice Ravindra Ghuge warned that contempt proceedings could be initiated against the assistant commissioner.
The administration later informed the court it had decided to restore the suspended licences.
items.summary: The Bombay High Court criticized the Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration for mechanically refusing to revoke suspended licences of five Mumbai Cricket Association eateries. The bench expressed displeasure that an official failed to apply his mind to a previous court direction. Acting Chief Justice Ravindra Ghuge warned that contempt proceedings could be initiated against the assistant commissioner. Later, the administration informed the court it had decided to restore the suspended licences.
items.title: Bombay High Court criticizes FDA for mechanical suspension of five Mumbai eateries

key_points: Sources told Reuters that HDFC Bank is likely to appoint Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha as its next CEO after Sashidhar Jagdishan retires in October.
The bank is also searching for an external candidate to comply with Reserve Bank of India guidelines requiring multiple names for the CEO position.
Bharucha, who has over 35 years of experience, currently leads multiple business units including Corporate Banking and Retail Assets.
The appointment comes amid investor uncertainty following recent leadership upheavals and a 27% decline in the bank's stock price this year.
items.summary: Sources told Reuters that HDFC Bank is likely to appoint Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha as its next CEO after Sashidhar Jagdishan retires in October. The bank is also searching for an external candidate to comply with Reserve Bank of India guidelines. Bharucha, who has over 35 years of experience, currently leads multiple business units including Corporate Banking and Retail Assets. The appointment comes amid investor uncertainty following recent leadership upheavals and a 27% decline in the bank's stock price this year.
items.title: HDFC Bank considers Kaizad Bharucha as next CEO candidate

key_points: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari assured refunds for 33,000 fans who attended a chaotic Lionel Messi event.
The refunds will be funded from the state's sports budget, but a specific timeline has not yet been announced.
Adhikari criticized the former government's poor management and noted that athlete appointment paperwork had been delayed for 11 years.
The event on December 13, 2025, ended in protests and vandalism due to crowd complaints about VIP presence and management.
items.summary: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announced refunds for 33,000 fans who paid Rs 4,000 and Rs 6,000 for a chaotic Lionel Messi event last year. The refund will come from the state sports budget, though no timeline has been set. Adhikari criticized the previous administration's management and highlighted systemic issues in the state's sports sector during a National Sports Day programme.
items.title: West Bengal CM promises refunds for 33,000 fans after chaotic Messi event

key_points: Foreign portfolio investors bought a net ₹30,919 crore of Indian equities in August.
This marks the first indication of a trend reversal after four consecutive months of heavy offloading.
V K Vijayakumar of Geojit Investments cited improving earnings growth as a key driver.
Total withdrawals for 2026 stand at ₹2.23 lakh crore, outpacing all of 2025.
Manish Bhandari of Vallum Capital stated that cash flows suggest returning conviction while futures suggest lingering caution.
items.summary: Foreign portfolio investors purchased a net ₹30,919 crore of Indian equities in August, extending their buying streak to two months. CDSL data shows this follows heavy offloading between March and June. V K Vijayakumar of Geojit Investments attributed the shift to improved earnings and rupee stability. Despite the recent optimism, total withdrawals for 2026 stand at ₹2.23 lakh crore. Manish Bhandari of Vallum Capital noted that cash flows suggest returning conviction while futures indicate lingering caution.
items.title: FPIs buy Indian equities for second month in August
